summary: Birkenstock Holding plc filed a 6-K reporting the closing of a secondary offering by BK LC Lux MidCo S.à r.l., selling 28,146,226 ordinary shares at $39.35 each. The company concurrently repurchased 12,761,613 shares via a redemption from the underwriter for about $500 million, cancelling them. J.P. Morgan acted as underwriter. The offering was under the existing F-3 shelf. The redemption reduces outstanding shares, returning capital to the company. Watch for post-close share count and potential overhang reduction from the selling shareholder's stake.
